device.name: SUMO-RL traffic signal control (single intersection, simulated)

facts.text: sumo-rl-v0 is registered with entry point sumo_rl.environment.env:SumoEnvironment and kwargs single_agent=True
SumoEnvironment is a gymnasium.Env for traffic signal control with the SUMO simulator
The environment module raises ImportError when SUMO_HOME is not set
The constructor requires net_file and route_file
num_seconds, the simulated seconds of one episode, defaults to 20000
delta_time, the simulated seconds between actions, defaults to 5 and yellow_time defaults to 2
min_green defaults to 5 s and max_green defaults to 50 s
sumo_seed defaults to 'random', so a run without a reset seed is not reproducible
sim_max_time is begin_time plus num_seconds
reset closes the previous simulation, increments the episode, masks a supplied seed to 31 bits and starts SUMO again
For single_agent the reset returns (observation, info)
For single_agent step returns (observation, reward, terminated, truncated, info); terminated is always False and truncated is dones['__all__']
The episode truncates when sim_step is at least sim_max_time
close stops the SUMO simulation and sets self.sumo to None
sumo_seed is passed to SUMO as --seed unless it is 'random', which passes --random
The action space is Discrete(num_green_phases), one action per green phase
The default reward is the change in cumulative vehicle delay, with waiting times divided by 100
The default observation concatenates the one-hot green phase, a min-green flag, lane densities and lane queues
The observation space is Box from 0 to 1 with length num_green_phases + 1 + 2 * len(lanes)
The upstream gym test creates sumo-rl-v0 with the single-intersection network and num_seconds=100
The single-intersection network has two incoming lanes from the north and two from the west
The single-intersection network declares two green phases and two yellow phases

determinism.notes: A reset seed is masked to 31 bits and passed to SUMO as --seed (env.py:228-231, :269-270); cap.world.seed.v1 supplies the seed of the next reset.  The upstream default sumo_seed is 'random' (env.py:117), so a run without a seed is not reproducible.  The fake reseeds its initial lane loads with Python's random.Random(seed); the SUMO backend was not run, so agreement between the two was not measured.

gaps: F0: the fake is an analytic/kinematic stand-in and models no vehicle dynamics, car-following, lane changing, routing, traffic-signal timing or TraCI interaction; the SUMO engine itself models traffic dynamics but was not run for this package (SUMO_HOME, sumolib and traci are external dependencies)
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, and each cap.world.step.v1 tick advances simulated time by timestep_ms (delta_time 5 s, env.py:106 and :143) only
no physical intersection or traffic light is modelled, and the model was never validated against SUMO or a real intersection

the fake backend is a pure-Python stand-in that returns Python floats (upstream returns float32 numpy arrays from TraCI), models one traffic signal with two green phases and four controlled lanes (the single-intersection network of tests/gym_test.py:8-14), and was not compared with the upstream environment; SUMO and sumo-rl were not installed where the gate ran
snapshot and restore are not offered: SumoEnvironment exposes no get_state/set_state, and a reset closes and restarts the SUMO simulation (env.py:263-271)

the sim backend was not run: it needs SUMO_HOME and the upstream package installed, and gym.make('sumo-rl-v0', **env_kwargs) with the configured net_file and route_file paths (relative to the repository root)

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
